script:
set -eu
unset LC_ALL
export LC_CTYPE=UTF-8

case "$selection" in
  *[![:space:]]*) ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' 'Text is empty' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

/usr/bin/osascript - "$selection" <<'APPLESCRIPT'
on hasText(sourceText)
    repeat with characterText in characters of sourceText
        set characterValue to characterText as text
        if characterValue is not space and characterValue is not tab then
            return true
        end if
    end repeat
    return false
end hasText

on joinLines(linesToJoin)
    set previousDelimiters to AppleScript's text item delimiters
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to linefeed
    set joinedText to linesToJoin as text
    set AppleScript's text item delimiters to previousDelimiters
    return joinedText
end joinLines

on run arguments
    set reminderText to item 1 of arguments
    set reminderName to ""
    set reminderLines to {}
    set foundName to false

    repeat with lineText in paragraphs of reminderText
        set candidate to lineText as text
        if foundName then
            set end of reminderLines to candidate
        else if my hasText(candidate) then
            set reminderName to candidate
            set foundName to true
        end if
    end repeat
    if not foundName then error "Text is empty"

    set reminderNotes to my joinLines(reminderLines)
    tell application "/System/Applications/Reminders.app"
        make new reminder at default list with properties {name:reminderName, body:reminderNotes}
    end tell
    return ""
end run
APPLESCRIPT

en.name: Create Apple Reminder
en.description: Create a reminder in the default Reminders list from the selected text.

zh-CN.name: 新建 Apple 提醒事项
zh-CN.description: 使用选中文本在默认提醒事项列表中创建提醒
